context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/tools defaults to is_sold={$ne:true} (helpers.py:78) — to see sold-split records you MUST pass ?is_sold=true. ToolCreate does NOT accept for_sale/sale_price/sale_listed_at; flip them via PUT /api/tools/{id} after create. There is no PATCH on /tools/{id} — only PUT (PATCH returns 405). Pro login endpoint (/api/auth/login) is rate-limited 5/min/IP just like ryan's — cache the token if you re-run. Wishlist API path is /api/wishlist (not /api/wish-items). ryan@ryan.com has 0 wishlist items, so DOM-level menu-button count for wish-menu-* will be 0 there — to UI-verify the ellipsis menu, either seed an item or use the Pro account's existing wishlist if any.
rca_of_issue: Bug RCA — Before the fix, mark_tool_sold's partial branch likely just decremented `quantity` without persisting any sold-history record, so the sold units disappeared from Vault → Sale History. The fix (routes_tool_actions.py:65–90) clones the original doc, gives it a fresh uuid + sold/for_sale flags, and inserts it as a SEPARATE tools-collection record. The live tool's quantity is decremented in place. Mitigation/verification: pytest test_partial_sale_creates_sold_split_record asserts (a) live tool qty drops 2→1, (b) a NEW tool record with same name + is_sold=true + quantity=1 + sold_to='TEST_buyer' exists in GET /api/tools?is_sold=true, (c) the split record survives even after the live tool's for_sale flag is later cleared. All three assertions pass.
